page_title: LocalSR: image and video restoration, on your computer

sources.entry: LocalSR - Open-source app for upscaling, denoising and restoring photos and videos with local AI models. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/HerRei/local-upscale) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: LocalSR
summary.one_liner: LocalSR is a free, open-source desktop app that upscales, denoises, deblurs and enhances photos and videos using AI models that run entirely on your own computer.
use_cases: enlarge a phone photo 2x to 4x without uploading it
restore a scanned or old photo
remove noise and JPEG artifacts from photos
fix motion blur in a photo
enhance a video frame by frame
batch upscale a folder of images
summary.what_it_does: LocalSR upscales photos and artwork by 2x, 3x or 4x, with Quick and Best treatments that use different models. It also has models for noise, motion blur and JPEG artifacts, which can be applied before enlarging or used alone to repair without resizing. Video is enhanced one frame at a time while keeping source timing, rotation and audio. It can process a whole folder or a queue and save setups as recipes, and it reads JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, AVIF, camera RAW and HEIC on a Mac. Results are saved as new files, and a before/after slider and an M-key toggle help compare them with the original.
notable: Runs AI models locally with no upload, no account; the page says the Mac app sends only an anonymous update-check count, which can be turned off
MIT-licensed open source; individual models keep their own licences shown before download
GPU editions for Apple Silicon (Neural Engine/MPS), NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm and DirectML
Model library can load user-supplied model files, e.g. from OpenModelDB
caveats: Windows installer is unsigned and not yet code-signed, so SmartScreen warns; Windows and Linux builds have had less manual testing than the Mac build and do not self-update yet
Upscaling estimates detail and can invent plausible but incorrect faces, text or patterns, especially at 4x; video can flicker and long clips or large images can take hours
Version is v0.4.0-beta, so features may change
